name: Drawing Copper Wire
Conversion Process PUP-Derived ULSD (Pyrolysis and Upgrading Both On-Site- Including Pretreatment) in Nth-plants. Energy Allocation
notes:
Base case refers to the allocation method.
Fuel gas is combusted to meet only internal heat demand and the remaining fuel gas is subsequently treated as energy products with energy allocation method.
Waxes are produced and accounted in the carbon balance but are not considered an energy product for purposes of the energy allocation factor estimation.
Char is landfilled and therefore is not considered an energy product.
Credit of carbon sequestration from char sent to landfill is also considered in the CO2 emissions estimation.

Source: 
Benavides et al, (2022) Life-cycle Analysis of Conversion of Post-Use Plastic via Pyrolysis with the GREET Model
https://doi.org/10.2172/1885570

name: Calendering (Polystyrene)
Polyethylene furanoate (PEF): EtOH pretreatment + Enzymatic hydrolysis end-of-life
notes:
Kim, T. et al. Life Cycle Greenhouse Gas Emissions, Water and Fossil-Fuel Consumption for Polyethylene Furanoate and its Co-Products from Lignocellulosic Biomass, ACS Sustainable Chemistry & Engineering, 2021, Publication in preparation. 
This process takes account for the amount of carbon uptaken in the PEF after end-of-life stage. 
Currently, it is assumed that there is no degradation of PEF in its end-of-life, and 100% of the carbon uptaken in 1 ton of PEF (i.e., 1754.646kgCO2/ton-PEF) is given. 
The users are welcome to change this uptake credit value based on a more accurate end-of-life analysis.
